title: Lease ATS delivery claims so a crash mid-POST cannot strand a hire in pending
deviations_from_card: 8 cases, not 7: added 4b (Replay on a STRANDED pending row answers ok after an in-place reclaim; on a LIVE lease it stays NOT_REPLAYABLE). Case 5 is the critic's byte-equality pin, built end to end: a dispatch whose fetch never returns (= crash mid-POST) is reclaimed and redelivered in one sweep with the same Idempotency-Key, a byte-identical body and the same header set (only X-Kp-Timestamp/X-Kp-Signature move, by design), then the zombie's late finalize is proved not to overwrite. API shape kept backward-compatible to avoid churning 4 sibling test files outside the write set: new openAtsDelivery -> {id, token} and leaseAtsDelivery -> token|null; recordAtsDeliveryStart (-> id) and claimAtsDelivery (-> boolean) stay as thin wrappers that still write a lease; finalizeAtsDelivery(id, outcome, tokenOrDate?, now?) enforces status='pending' AND lease_token=? when given a token (ats-egress always passes one) and keeps the attempts-only CAS for fixtures passing a Date. Wrote neither ats-egress-delivery.test.ts (unchanged, 17/17 green) nor anything outside the write set. retryDueAtsDeliveries' summary gains an additive `reclaimed` field (internal; instrumentation logs it). A lease-less pending row from before the upgrade is treated as expired once updated_at is older than one lease, so already-stranded production rows heal.
notes: Lease = 5 min (ATS_DELIVERY_LEASE_MS). Columns are additive ALTERs in the store's own db() (ats-config-store precedent); no core.ts, no tenancy change. No await inside any transaction; the reaper is a per-row conditional UPDATE re-asserting token+deadline. Mutation-proved: dropping the holder predicate from finalize turns cases 3 and 5 red. GATES: tsc exit 2 but ONLY on foreign paths - after my commits the sole errors are in the untracked kpi-sim/ tree (earlier also sibling billing/analytics in-flight files); 0 errors in any ats file. Full test:unit exit 1 ONLY from sibling uncommitted billing work: route-capability-coverage BROKEN on billing/alerts/[id]/route.ts [POST], billing/alerts.test.ts FLAKE; all 104 ats tests green. test:perf on the dirty tree is red from siblings' combined share; measured base 683975a63 + my 3 files alone in an exported tree (git archive, scripts/perf/check-budget.mjs): my first cut put 10 route graphs 1-2 KB over (they reach ats-egress via pipeline-entry-action), so I trimmed my own comments rather than raise a ceiling - base + mine now passes check-budget with no ceiling change. api:check 0 (GET body additive, no route/method change). lint:ts-ratchet 0. i18n/design not applicable (no strings, no classNames).
